title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode5 A New Heat

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, here's your Viennese coffee refill.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Mmm... This smells delicious!
You really do make the best coffee in the world, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I know what you're doing.
No amount of praise is getting you any ice cream today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
H-Haha. I was just giving you my honest opinion...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Akito! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, are you by yourself today?
We figured that you'd all come over together since we heard that you'd be participating in an event today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, about that...
I came to practice on my own after we split in the evening.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really?! You're going to practice?! Right after an event?! Your work ethic really is admirable, Akito.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Between the walls in SEKAI coming down and the tree in the plaza growing bigger, quite a lot has been happening recently...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These changes must be happening because of the passion you and the others possess! I'm really looking forward to seeing what happens next!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Passion...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
Nothing major happened. It's just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't you tell me what's on your mind?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, again...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't have to tell me if you're not comfortable, but it might feel good to get things off your chest. I mean, we've been through this before, haven't we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, why don't you tell me all about what's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, if you don't mind listening for a second...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
You're not feeling as driven as before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My brain knows that I need to keep doing what I can to reach our next goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it's like my heart isn't keeping up with it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't think there's any reason for you to be feeling so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've been doing absolutely everything you can to make a very big dream come true, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your heart may be telling you that it needs some time to recharge right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that also crossed my mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, from where I'm standing, it seems only natural that you're not chasing this new dream with the same amount of fervor as before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, why's that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because his dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND was born out of actually witnessing that event. Seeing it is what inspired him, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But he and the others are now trying to “stand on top of the world”, and I'm not sure they quite know what that means yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This dream was born under far different circumstances. So, it seems only natural not to go after it in the same way as before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I get what MEIKO's saying...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But... That doesn't really explain why I haven't been able to perform at my best lately...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Let's say MEIKO's right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If seeing RAD WEEKEND is what lit that fire inside of you all those years ago, then you may just need something to help rekindle that flame, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something to rekindle the flame inside of me...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But what are the odds of me seeing another event or anything like that again...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It may actually be hiding right under your nose.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, I can't really say what that is yet...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you understand how big the world is, yes, Akito?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You began dreaming of surpassing RAD WEEKEND after just happening to come across it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, you might find something else that rekindles the flame inside of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The world is a big place. It's full of things that we don't know about and opportunities we can't imagine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, as long as you strive towards your goal of standing on top of the world, I'm sure you'll come across that special something eventually.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The world is a big place, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You might have a point there...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is rare of you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?! Rare?! You must be joking!
I'm always trying to give the best advice I can to all of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's saying that because of how you act on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, MEIKO, not you too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll come across it eventually, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Obviously, believing that isn't going to get me out of my current situation. But...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It does beat feeling anxious and running around in circles.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (In any case, I just gotta keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Like I've been doing until now.)
